text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit parking at all times on the east side of Gwendolen Crescent, near the driveway access of a property located at No. 17 Gwendolen Crescent. This is in response to concerns regarding vehicles parking near the driveway, causing sightline issues when motorists are exiting the driveway. This report also identifies and rectifies a conflicting parking by-law on Gwendolen Crescent by introducing a "house-keeping" by-law amendment.

North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times, on the east side of Gwendolen Crescent, between a point 5.5 metres north of the driveway of 17 Gwendolen Crescent and a point 5.5 metres south of the driveway of 17 Gwendolen Crescent. 2. Prohibited parking at all times, on both sides of Gwendolen Crescent, between Gwendolen Avenue and the south end.
